mapper.sql:
SELECT CONCAT('in-', pi.id) AS rowKey, s.id AS partyId, s.name AS partyName, COALESCE(pi.dept_id, s.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, pi.purchaser AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, NULL AS productId, NULL AS productCode, NULL AS productName, NULL AS brand, NULL AS standard, NULL AS drawingNo, pi.no AS no, pi.in_time AS bizDate, '采购入库' AS docType, 1 AS bizType, IFNULL(pi.total_count, 0) AS inCount, IFNULL(pi.total_price, 0) AS inAmount, 0 AS returnCount, 0 AS returnAmount, IFNULL(pi.total_price, 0) AS netAmount, 0 AS pendingQty FROM erp_purchase_in pi INNER JOIN erp_supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(pi.dept_id, s.dept_id) LEFT JOIN system_users su ON su.id = pi.purchaser AND su.deleted = b'0' WHERE pi.deleted = 0 AND pi.status = 20
UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('return-', pr.id) AS rowKey, s.id AS partyId, s.name AS partyName, COALESCE(pr.dept_id, s.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, pr.purchaser AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, NULL AS productId, NULL AS productCode, NULL AS productName, NULL AS brand, NULL AS standard, NULL AS drawingNo, pr.no AS no, pr.return_time AS bizDate, '采购退货' AS docType, 2 AS bizType, 0 AS inCount, 0 AS inAmount, IFNULL(pr.total_count, 0) AS returnCount, IFNULL(pr.total_price, 0) AS returnAmount, -IFNULL(pr.total_price, 0) AS netAmount, 0 AS pendingQty FROM erp_purchase_return pr INNER JOIN erp_supplier s ON s.id = pr.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(pr.dept_id, s.dept_id) LEFT JOIN system_users su ON su.id = pr.purchaser AND su.deleted = b'0' WHERE pr.deleted = 0 AND pr.status = 20

SELECT CONCAT('in-', pi.id, '-', pii.id) AS rowKey, s.id AS partyId, s.name AS partyName, COALESCE(pii.dept_id, pi.dept_id, s.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, pi.purchaser AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, p.id AS productId, p.code AS productCode, p.name AS productName, COALESCE(pii.brand, p.brand) AS brand, p.standard AS standard, COALESCE(pii.drawing_no, p.drawing_no) AS drawingNo, pi.no AS no, pi.in_time AS bizDate, '采购入库' AS docType, 1 AS bizType, IFNULL(pii.count, 0) AS inCount, IFNULL(pii.total_price, 0) AS inAmount, 0 AS returnCount, 0 AS returnAmount, IFNULL(pii.total_price, 0) AS netAmount, 0 AS pendingQty FROM erp_purchase_in_items pii INNER JOIN erp_purchase_in pi ON pi.id = pii.in_id AND pi.deleted = 0 AND pi.status = 20 INNER JOIN erp_supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_product p ON p.id = pii.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(pii.dept_id, pi.dept_id, s.dept_id) LEFT JOIN system_users su ON su.id = pi.purchaser AND su.deleted = b'0' WHERE pii.deleted = 0
UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('return-', pr.id, '-', pri.id) AS rowKey, s.id AS partyId, s.name AS partyName, COALESCE(pri.dept_id, pr.dept_id, s.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, pr.purchaser AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, p.id AS productId, p.code AS productCode, p.name AS productName, COALESCE(pri.brand, p.brand) AS brand, p.standard AS standard, COALESCE(pri.drawing_no, p.drawing_no) AS drawingNo, pr.no AS no, pr.return_time AS bizDate, '采购退货' AS docType, 2 AS bizType, 0 AS inCount, 0 AS inAmount, IFNULL(pri.count, 0) AS returnCount, IFNULL(pri.total_price, 0) AS returnAmount, -IFNULL(pri.total_price, 0) AS netAmount, 0 AS pendingQty FROM erp_purchase_return_items pri INNER JOIN erp_purchase_return pr ON pr.id = pri.return_id AND pr.deleted = 0 AND pr.status = 20 INNER JOIN erp_supplier s ON s.id = pr.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_product p ON p.id = pri.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(pri.dept_id, pr.dept_id, s.dept_id) LEFT JOIN system_users su ON su.id = pr.purchaser AND su.deleted = b'0' WHERE pri.deleted = 0

SELECT CONCAT('order-', po.id, '-', poi.id) AS rowKey, s.id AS partyId, s.name AS partyName, COALESCE(poi.dept_id, po.dept_id, s.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, po.purchaser AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, p.id AS productId, p.code AS productCode, p.name AS productName, COALESCE(poi.brand, p.brand) AS brand, p.standard AS standard, COALESCE(poi.drawing_no, p.drawing_no) AS drawingNo, po.no AS no, po.order_time AS bizDate, '采购订单' AS docType, 3 AS bizType, 0 AS inCount, 0 AS inAmount, 0 AS returnCount, 0 AS returnAmount, 0 AS netAmount, GREATEST(IFNULL(poi.count, 0) - IFNULL(poi.in_count, 0), 0) AS pendingQty FROM erp_purchase_order_items poi INNER JOIN erp_purchase_order po ON po.id = poi.order_id AND po.deleted = 0 AND po.status = 20 INNER JOIN erp_supplier s ON s.id = po.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_product p ON p.id = poi.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(poi.dept_id, po.dept_id, s.dept_id) LEFT JOIN system_users su ON su.id = po.purchaser AND su.deleted = b'0' WHERE poi.deleted = 0

UNION ALL
) x
(x.no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR x.partyName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR x.deptName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR x.userName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR x.productCode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR x.productName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%'))

SELECT ${periodExpr} AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT d.rowKey) AS docCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.inCount), 0) AS inCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.inAmount), 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.returnCount), 0) AS returnCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.returnAmount), 0) AS returnAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.netAmount), 0) AS netAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.inAmount), 0) AS purchaseAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.inCount), 0) AS purchaseCount FROM () d WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY ${periodExpr} ORDER BY period ASC

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.code, SUM(r.inAmount) AS inAmount, SUM(r.returnAmount) AS returnAmount, SUM(r.netAmount) AS netAmount, SUM(r.pendingQty) AS pendingQty, COUNT(*) AS count, ${orderBy} AS value FROM ( SELECT partyId AS id, partyName AS name, NULL AS code, inAmount, returnAmount, netAmount, pendingQty FROM ( UNION ALL ) d WHERE 1 = 1 ) r GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.code ORDER BY ${orderBy} DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

choose.otherwise: SELECT partyId AS id, MAX(partyName) AS name, MAX(userName) AS userName, MAX(deptName) AS deptName, SUM(inCount) AS inCount, SUM(inAmount) AS inAmount, SUM(returnCount) AS returnCount, SUM(returnAmount) AS returnAmount, SUM(netAmount) AS netAmount, SUM(pendingQty) AS pendingQty FROM ( UNION ALL ) d WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY partyId

SELECT CONCAT('out-', so.id) AS rowKey, c.id AS partyId, c.name AS partyName, COALESCE(so.dept_id, c.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, so.sale_user_id AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, NULL AS productId, NULL AS productCode, NULL AS productName, NULL AS brand, NULL AS standard, so.no AS no, so.out_time AS bizDate, '销售出库' AS docType, 1 AS bizType, IFNULL(so.total_count, 0) AS saleCount, IFNULL(so.total_price, 0) AS saleAmount, 0 AS returnCount, 0 AS returnAmount, IFNULL(so.total_price, 0) AS netAmount FROM erp_sale_out so INNER JOIN erp_customer c ON c.id = so.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(so.dept_id, c.dept_id) LEFT JOIN system_users su ON su.id = so.sale_user_id WHERE so.deleted = 0 AND so.status = 20
UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('return-', sr.id) AS rowKey, c.id AS partyId, c.name AS partyName, COALESCE(sr.dept_id, c.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, sr.sale_user_id AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, NULL AS productId, NULL AS productCode, NULL AS productName, NULL AS brand, NULL AS standard, sr.no AS no, sr.return_time AS bizDate, '销售退货' AS docType, 2 AS bizType, 0 AS saleCount, 0 AS saleAmount, IFNULL(sr.total_count, 0) AS returnCount, IFNULL(sr.total_price, 0) AS returnAmount, -IFNULL(sr.total_price, 0) AS netAmount FROM erp_sale_return sr INNER JOIN erp_customer c ON c.id = sr.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(sr.dept_id, c.dept_id) LEFT JOIN system_users su ON su.id = sr.sale_user_id WHERE sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.status = 20

SELECT CONCAT('out-', so.id, '-', soi.id) AS rowKey, c.id AS partyId, c.name AS partyName, COALESCE(soi.dept_id, so.dept_id, c.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, so.sale_user_id AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, p.id AS productId, p.code AS productCode, p.name AS productName, COALESCE(soi.brand, p.brand) AS brand, p.standard AS standard, so.no AS no, so.out_time AS bizDate, '销售出库' AS docType, 1 AS bizType, IFNULL(soi.count, 0) AS saleCount, IFNULL(soi.total_price, 0) AS saleAmount, 0 AS returnCount, 0 AS returnAmount, IFNULL(soi.total_price, 0) AS netAmount FROM erp_sale_out_items soi INNER JOIN erp_sale_out so ON so.id = soi.out_id AND so.deleted = 0 AND so.status = 20 INNER JOIN erp_customer c ON c.id = so.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_product p ON p.id = soi.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(soi.dept_id, so.dept_id, c.dept_id) LEFT JOIN system_users su ON su.id = so.sale_user_id WHERE soi.deleted = 0
UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('return-', sr.id, '-', sri.id) AS rowKey, c.id AS partyId, c.name AS partyName, COALESCE(sri.dept_id, sr.dept_id, c.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, sr.sale_user_id AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, p.id AS productId, p.code AS productCode, p.name AS productName, COALESCE(sri.brand, p.brand) AS brand, p.standard AS standard, sr.no AS no, sr.return_time AS bizDate, '销售退货' AS docType, 2 AS bizType, 0 AS saleCount, 0 AS saleAmount, IFNULL(sri.count, 0) AS returnCount, IFNULL(sri.total_price, 0) AS returnAmount, -IFNULL(sri.total_price, 0) AS netAmount FROM erp_sale_return_items sri INNER JOIN erp_sale_return sr ON sr.id = sri.return_id AND sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.status = 20 INNER JOIN erp_customer c ON c.id = sr.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_product p ON p.id = sri.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(sri.dept_id, sr.dept_id, c.dept_id) LEFT JOIN system_users su ON su.id = sr.sale_user_id WHERE sri.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.partyId) AS customerCount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.rowKey) AS docCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.saleCount), 0) AS saleCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.saleAmount), 0) AS saleAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.returnCount), 0) AS returnCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.returnAmount), 0) AS returnAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.netAmount), 0) AS netAmount FROM () d WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT ${periodExpr} AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT d.rowKey) AS docCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.saleCount), 0) AS saleCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.saleAmount), 0) AS saleAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.returnCount), 0) AS returnCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.returnAmount), 0) AS returnAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.netAmount), 0) AS netAmount FROM () d WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY ${periodExpr} ORDER BY period ASC

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.code, SUM(r.saleAmount) AS saleAmount, SUM(r.returnAmount) AS returnAmount, SUM(r.netAmount) AS netAmount, COUNT(*) AS count, ${orderBy} AS value FROM ( SELECT partyId AS id, partyName AS name, NULL AS code, saleAmount, returnAmount, netAmount FROM () d WHERE 1 = 1 ) r GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.code ORDER BY ${orderBy} DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

choose.when: SELECT productId AS id, MAX(productCode) AS code, MAX(productName) AS name, MAX(brand) AS brand, MAX(standard) AS standard, SUM(saleCount) AS saleCount, SUM(saleAmount) AS saleAmount, SUM(returnCount) AS returnCount, SUM(returnAmount) AS returnAmount, SUM(netAmount) AS netAmount FROM () d WHERE productId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY productId

SELECT deptId AS id, COALESCE(MAX(deptName), '未设置部门') AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT partyId) AS customerCount, SUM(saleCount) AS saleCount, SUM(saleAmount) AS saleAmount, SUM(returnCount) AS returnCount, SUM(returnAmount) AS returnAmount, SUM(netAmount) AS netAmount FROM () d WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY deptId

SELECT userId AS id, COALESCE(MAX(userName), '未设置业务员') AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT partyId) AS customerCount, SUM(saleCount) AS saleCount, SUM(saleAmount) AS saleAmount, SUM(returnCount) AS returnCount, SUM(returnAmount) AS returnAmount, SUM(netAmount) AS netAmount FROM () d WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY userId
SELECT rowKey, partyName AS customerName, deptName, userName, docType, no AS docNo, bizDate AS docDate, saleCount + returnCount AS bizCount, saleAmount, returnAmount, netAmount FROM () d WHERE 1 = 1
choose.otherwise: SELECT partyId AS id, MAX(partyName) AS name, MAX(userName) AS userName, MAX(deptName) AS deptName, SUM(saleCount) AS saleCount, SUM(saleAmount) AS saleAmount, SUM(returnCount) AS returnCount, SUM(returnAmount) AS returnAmount, SUM(netAmount) AS netAmount FROM () d WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY partyId

sql.if: AND (p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR p.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR p.standard LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR p.drawing_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR w.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%'))

choose.when: AND IFNULL(st.count, 0) >= 0 AND p.stock_min IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(st.count, 0) < p.stock_min

mapper.sql: SELECT st.id AS stockId, st.product_id AS productId, p.code AS productCode, p.name AS productName, p.brand AS brand, p.standard AS standard, p.drawing_no AS drawingNo, p.category_id AS categoryId, pc.name AS categoryName, st.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, COALESCE(st.dept_id, w.dept_id) AS deptId, sd.name AS deptName, IFNULL(st.count, 0) AS stockQty, IFNULL(st.cost_amount, 0) AS stockAmount, IFNULL(st.occupied_count, 0) AS occupiedQty, IFNULL(st.count, 0) - IFNULL(st.occupied_count, 0) AS availableQty, IFNULL(st.in_transit_count, IFNULL(st.pending_in_count, 0)) AS inTransitQty, p.stock_min AS stockMin, GREATEST(IFNULL(p.stock_min, 0) - IFNULL(st.count, 0), 0) AS gapQty, CASE WHEN IFNULL(st.count, 0) < 0 THEN '负库存' WHEN IFNULL(st.count, 0) = 0 THEN '零库存' WHEN p.stock_min IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(st.count, 0) < p.stock_min THEN '低库存' ELSE '正常' END AS risk FROM erp_stock st LEFT JOIN erp_product p ON p.id = st.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_product_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id AND pc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_warehouse w ON w.id = st.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_dept sd ON sd.id = COALESCE(st.dept_id, w.dept_id) WHERE st.deleted = b'0'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.productId) AS skuCount, COALESCE(SUM(x.stockQty), 0) AS stockQty, COALESCE(SUM(x.stockAmount), 0) AS stockAmount, COALESCE(SUM(x.occupiedQty), 0) AS occupiedQty, COALESCE(SUM(x.availableQty), 0) AS availableQty, COALESCE(SUM(x.inTransitQty), 0) AS inTransitQty, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.risk = '低库存' THEN x.productId END) AS lowStockSku, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.risk = '零库存' THEN x.productId END) AS zeroStockSku, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.risk = '负库存' THEN x.productId END) AS negativeStockSku FROM () x

SELECT r.id, r.name, SUM(r.stockQty) AS stockQty, SUM(r.stockAmount) AS stockAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT r.productId) AS count, ${orderBy} AS value FROM ( SELECT warehouseId AS id, warehouseName AS name, productId, stockQty, stockAmount FROM () stock_rank_base ) r GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY ${orderBy} DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

choose.when: SELECT warehouseId AS id, MAX(warehouseName) AS name, MAX(deptName) AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT productId) AS skuCount, SUM(stockQty) AS stockQty, SUM(stockAmount) AS stockAmount, SUM(occupiedQty) AS occupiedQty, SUM(availableQty) AS availableQty, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk = '低库存' THEN productId END) AS lowStockSku FROM () d GROUP BY warehouseId

SELECT categoryId AS id, COALESCE(MAX(categoryName), '未设置分类') AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT productId) AS skuCount, SUM(stockQty) AS stockQty, SUM(stockAmount) AS stockAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk = '低库存' THEN productId END) AS lowStockSku FROM () d GROUP BY categoryId
SELECT stockId AS id, productCode AS code, productName AS name, warehouseName, categoryName, stockQty, stockAmount, stockMin, gapQty, risk FROM () d WHERE risk != '正常'
choose.otherwise: SELECT productId AS id, MAX(productCode) AS code, MAX(productName) AS name, MAX(brand) AS brand, MAX(standard) AS standard, MAX(categoryName) AS categoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT warehouseId) AS warehouseCount, SUM(stockQty) AS stockQty, SUM(stockAmount) AS stockAmount, SUM(occupiedQty) AS occupiedQty, SUM(availableQty) AS availableQty, MAX(stockMin) AS stockMin, GREATEST(MAX(stockMin) - SUM(stockQty), 0) AS gapQty, CASE WHEN SUM(stockQty) < 0 THEN '负库存' WHEN SUM(stockQty) = 0 THEN '零库存' WHEN MAX(stockMin) IS NOT NULL AND SUM(stockQty) < MAX(stockMin) THEN '低库存' ELSE '正常' END AS risk FROM () d GROUP BY productId
